figurative_meaning_en: To give one's word or promise, often in the context of marriage or formal commitment
example_sentences_in_bangla: তিনি তার মেয়ের বিয়ের জন্য কথা দিয়েছেন।
আমি তোমাকে সাহায্য করার কথা দিচ্ছি।
example_sentences_in_english: He has given his word for his daughter's marriage.
I give you my word that I will help.
note: Commonly used in arranged marriage contexts in Bengali culture
